entries.en: to join and lengthen; to extend by joining.
to add height to; to heighten, to make higher.

entries.zh: 接合断处；把断掉的东西接补起来。
entries.en: to join what is broken; to splice, to mend by joining.

entries.zh: 如接线般相继接上；依次接续。
entries.en: to add in succession, like joining threads; to continue one after another.
entries.notes: M、R 两栏仅记一音节，与 H 栏二字未完全对应；按 L「如线相接」取相继接续之义。

entries.zh: 接续跟随；如讲史、接线般一环接一环地连下去。
entries.en: to follow on in sequence, as a story continues or threads are joined one to another.
entries.notes: H 栏存疑（相/月、跟/限），从「相跟」取连贯相续之义。

entries.zh: 补贴他；给他添补（如加薪）。
entries.en: to supplement (him); to give an additional allowance, e.g. extra salary.
entries.notes: R 栏已删，L 第二句疑为「añadir salario al embaxador」，故取补贴、加薪之义。

entries.en: to add again; to add more.
entries.notes: H 栏「月添」存疑，疑作「再添」，与 L「añadir」相合。

entries.zh: 再添；再添加（原件此条多处已划删）。
entries.en: to add again; to add more (entry largely struck out in the manuscript).
entries.notes: L 末字不成词、M 栏已删，仅 R 栏指向「再添」，故降为低置信。

entries.zh: 一再添加；屡次添补（存疑）。
entries.en: to add repeatedly; to add again and again (uncertain).
entries.notes: H 栏「月月」存疑，R 栏作「再再」，义为一再添补，然大部不明，存疑。

entries.zh: 再走几步；再添几步路程。
entries.en: to go a few more steps; to add a few more steps.
entries.notes: H 首字存疑，L 句末残（con po sv.），按「再行几步」取义。

entries.en: to add words; to interject, to say more.
to sole a shoe; to add a sole to a shoe.
entries.notes: H「拍鞋」字面为打鞋，据 L「加鞋底」取上底、补鞋底之义。

entries.en: besides; in addition; separately.
to drown; to be drowned.
entries.notes: H 栏「清」存疑（清/淹），按 L「ahogarse」取「淹」。

entries.en: to be flooded; to be drowned in water.
entries.notes: L 的「fica」费解，H、M、R 均作「淹水」，故取淹水之义。

entries.en: (of a ship) to sink, to founder.
(of a sown field) to be buried and smothered by sand.
entries.notes: H 首字存疑（汰/洗），L 句末残，按沙埋农田取义。

entries.en: angels; heavenly beings.

entries.zh: 仙人；天使（原件此条部分已删）。
entries.en: immortals; angels (entry partly deleted in the manuscript).
entries.notes: L「de cloisa」费解且标[部分已删]，M栏亦删，仅 H、R 可据，降为低置信。

entries.en: guardian angel; divine assistance.
entries.notes: L 为守护天使，H、M、R 均作「神助」，两义并列，取 L 为主。

entries.en: narrow.
entries.notes: M 栏污损难辨（T99）仅存一字母，按 L、H、R 取「狭窄」。
